name: copilot-repo-roundtrip
description: Prompt-driven whole-repository modifications using the existing Copilot browser round-trip script.

copilotRoundtrip.pythonPath.description: Python executable with Playwright installed (use py on Windows if preferred).

copilotRoundtrip.model.description: Provider/model text entered in the sidebar (e.g. GPT/GPT-6).

copilotRoundtrip.timeout.description: Seconds without new on-screen Copilot output or a long-running task-card change before giving up.

copilotRoundtrip.allowDirty.description: Allow dirty working tree; snapshot still uses HEAD only.

copilotRoundtrip.profilePath.description: Optional browser profile path (blank uses Python script default).

copilotRoundtrip.workDir.description: Optional download and diagnostic directory outside the target repository.

copilotRoundtrip.backupDir.description: Optional backup directory outside the target repository.

copilotRoundtrip.showBrowser.description: Show the browser during repository modifications. Sign-in always opens a visible browser.

copilotRoundtrip.temporaryChat.description: Enable Copilot Temporary chat before selecting the model (initial state of the sidebar checkbox for new chats). Temporary chats are not kept in chat history; chats run with Temporary chat off are saved and continue the same Copilot chat.
